backend/main.mo: Motoko canister managing user profiles and admin-gated image uploads with access control, blob storage mixins, and image metadata mapping.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing UI/UX feature requirements, affected frontend files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing responsibilities of each major frontend file including components, hooks, data, and styles.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind-based stylesheet defining theme variables, dark mode tokens, base styles, and animation-related utilities.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry file mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app wiring category selection, hover state, HDDHub rendering, and overlay display inside the PortfolioShell.
frontend/src/components/CategoryModal.ts: Empty placeholder file for a category modal component.
Empty placeholder file intended for category overlay logic.
frontend/src/components/HDDHub.tsx: Empty placeholder file for HDD visualization component.
frontend/src/components/PhotoGalleryOver: Empty placeholder file for the photo gallery overlay component.
frontend/src/components/PortfolioShell.t: Empty placeholder file for outer layout shell component.
frontend/src/components/StudioComponents: Large module implementing PortfolioShell, VinylPlayer, and other UI pieces with asset fallback logic and responsive behavior.
frontend/src/components/VinylPlayer.tsx: Empty placeholder file for vinyl player component.
frontend/src/data/categories.ts: Defines fourteen portfolio categories with IDs, names, and descriptions.
frontend/src/data/categoryOverlayContent: Defines overlay data structures and provides placeholder photo and text sections for various categories.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, refreshing dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides context and hooks for managing Internet Identity authentication, including login, logout, and identity persistence.
frontend/src/hooks/usePhotoGallery.ts: Implements React Query hooks for listing, uploading, and checking admin access for images via the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Sets global Tailwind styles, color tokens, and utility classes including glass and animation effects.
frontend/src/lib/assetFallbacks.ts: Empty placeholder module for asset fallback logic.
frontend/src/lib/assets.ts: Resolves asset URLs, defines canonical asset paths, and provides fallback chains with optional SVG placeholders.
frontend/src/lib/assetUrls.ts: Empty placeholder module for asset URL definitions.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Exports a utility function combining clsx and tailwind-merge for class name merging.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider before rendering App.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utilities for reading, storing, and clearing URL parameters with session persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind setup with dark mode, extended OKLCH color system, custom animations, and layout utilities plus typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
frontend/vite.config.ts: Vite config enabling React, environment variable injection, API proxying, and aliasing for the frontend build.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing design, architecture, UI interactions, and current issues for a portfolio site with HDD hub and modal system.
